title: Latent Sky data manifest
description: THE contract between pipeline/ (producer) and web/ (consumer). The web app renders only what this file declares; the pipeline emits this file last, after every referenced asset exists and every identity checksum has been verified.

init.description: Forecast initialisation time. Absent for dev-sample, whose frames are independent analysis times.

generatedNote.description: The scientific-honesty caption shown in the UI. Required — a build without it fails.

stormName.description: Optional display name of the event, e.g. "Typhoon Gaemi". First-class so the UI never has to parse it out of generatedNote; absent when no storm claim should be made.

heroFrame.description: Optional index into frames of the most developed frame — where 'enter the storm' should arrive. The pipeline gates it against frames.length (a JSON schema cannot cross-reference); absent, the UI falls back to the last frame.

placeLabel.description: Optional human label for the hero domain, e.g. "Taiwan · CWA model domain".

reportUrl.description: Optional URL of this run's verification report page, root-relative on the site (e.g. "/verification/stormcast-dixie-2025.html") or absolute. The UI links it from the caveat.

verification.description: Whether this run is enrolled in the observation-scoring loop, and how far it has got. ABSENT means no claim at all — the right value for a run nothing will ever score, such as a Taiwan typhoon with no MRMS coverage. "pending" says only that it has not been scored yet, which stays true however long that takes; it is deliberately not a promise about when. "scored" requires reportUrl.

verificationSummary.description: The one measured figure the UI states without the viewer opening the report. Emitted from the scorer's own results, never written by hand. Present only when verification is "scored".

thresholdDbz.description: Reflectivity threshold the skill was measured at.

usefulScaleKm.description: Smallest neighbourhood width reaching useful skill (0.5 + f0/2). NULL means the run never reached it at any tested scale — a real result that must be shown, not omitted.

largestScaleKm.description: The largest neighbourhood tested, so "none at any scale" can say up to what.

frames.description: Valid times, one per frame index, strictly increasing. Layer frame arrays index into this.

basemap.description: Optional offline-baked basemap imagery. Paths relative to the manifest. Licence must be public-domain or CC-BY (audited in licences/MANIFEST.yaml) — basemaps ship.

globalRect.description: west, south, east, north in degrees; defaults to [-180,-90,180,90]

hero.description: Crisp regional basemap over the hero rectangle

lut.description: Path to the 256x1 RGBA LUT PNG shared by every layer of this variable

identity.description: sha256 of the canonical (variable, lut sha256, vmin, vmax, alphaPolicy) tuple. The build FAILS if two layers of the same variable disagree. The web app asserts coarse/fine equality again at load.

frames.description: Relative WebP path per frame, same length and order as top-level frames

nativeKm.description: Native resolution of the SOURCE model for this layer, in km. First-class because the UI states it to the viewer: the reveal pills used to hardcode "2 km" and silently lied the moment a 3 km model shipped. Absent means the UI must say nothing rather than guess.

pairWith.description: For hero layers: the layer id this one is compared against in the reveal
